description: Exact pins for every tool the contracts pipeline downloads or invokes. Binaries are verified by SHA-256 before use and refused on mismatch. Node packages are pinned by package-lock.json integrity; Python packages by smoke/python/requirements.txt hashes; Gradle by the wrapper distributionSha256Sum and the wrapper jar hash below.

openapi_generator.why: One generator for all three targets (kotlin jvm-ktor + kotlinx.serialization, typescript-fetch, python pydantic v2) so a version bump is one reviewed change; supports type/import mappings that substitute the hand-written Money and Instant seams for the raw wire shapes; OpenAPI 3.1 input.

oasdiff.why: Purpose-built OpenAPI breaking-change classifier with stable change identifiers, a single static binary and no service dependency.

spectral.why: OpenAPI 3.1 aware linter with a committed ruleset and custom functions for the ADR-015 money, time and idempotency rules.
